name: Arbiter MCP
description: AI-powered Slack → Jira ticket triage agent. Classifies IT ticket severity (P0–P3), auto-resolves safe tickets, and escalates critical incidents to humans via Slack. Zero false-positive auto-resolutions. Built with LangGraph, MCP, FastAPI, and ChromaDB.

tools.name: triage_ticket
tools.description: Triage an IT support ticket or Slack message using Arbiter MCP's AI reasoning engine. Classifies severity (P0 CRITICAL → P3 LOW), retrieves similar resolved tickets from ChromaDB, calculates a deterministic trust score, and applies a hard safety override for production/security/billing/data-loss tickets. Returns category, severity, trust_score, risk_override, and decision (auto_resolve or escalate).

ticket_text.description: Full text of the IT support ticket or Slack message to triage

created_at.description: ISO 8601 creation timestamp (optional, defaults to now)

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Retrieve the status, trust score, risk flags, and full audit record for a previously triaged ticket.

ticket_id.description: Ticket ID to look up (e.g. IT-1024)

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List recent IT support tickets from the Arbiter MCP audit log, optionally filtered by decision outcome (auto_resolve or escalate).

limit.description: Maximum number of tickets to return (default 10, max 50)

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Return Arbiter MCP benchmark metrics: 77.5% classification accuracy, 20% auto-resolution rate, 0% false-positive auto-resolutions, 1.03s median triage latency on N=40 ticket benchmark.

jiraSiteUrl.description: Jira Cloud site URL (e.g. https://yourorg.atlassian.net). Leave empty for offline/demo mode.

jiraEmail.description: Jira account email for API authentication.

slackBotToken.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-...) for posting escalation cards.

slackSigningSecret.description: Slack app signing secret for HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification.

groqApiKey.description: Groq API key for fast LLM classification. Free tier sufficient.

gcpProjectId.description: Google Cloud project ID for Vertex AI summaries. Optional.
